name: KingTech KP-600 measured mounting fit test

component.name: KingTech KP-600 fuel pump

sources.body: User sketch, 2026-11-08: 48.5 mm case length × Ø27 mm; 31 mm overall height assumes the original reference’s 4 mm bottom elevation. Fittings and clamp appearance remain estimates.
sources.holes: User confirmed: 32 mm transverse hole centres, mounting line 15 mm from nipple-end (−X) body edge. Local centres (−9.25,−16), (−9.25,+16) mm. Original hardware diameter remains estimated Ø3 mm; printed pilots follow project settings.
sources.clearance: User fit check 2026-11-23: 40 mm inside gap between the C locator end walls across the pump (was 38.6 mm, too tight). Feet 10 mm wide, outer edge 3.7 mm beyond each hole centre; 0.3 mm clearance.

component.note: Measured 48.5 × Ø27 mm case; holes 32 mm apart at 15 mm from nipple-end body edge (33.5 mm from rear edge). No printed outline ribs by default. Supplied dummy STL is resized for reference only; clamp, feet, fitting details and 4 mm bottom elevation are estimates. Original hardware hole diameter not remeasured; default printed pilots are 1.5 mm. C-shaped foot locators: 10 mm feet ending 3.7 mm past each hole centre (40 mm between end walls); 2 mm walls, 0.3 mm clearance, 2.5 mm tall by default.
